title: Onboard Peregrine-11b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Add Peregrine-11b v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata, performance profiles for our inference fleet, and automation to append release notes to the changelog. Motivation: Peregrine is an open 11B family that our customers requested; onboarding includes model metadata, recommended serving configs (batching, kv-cache settings, quantization profiles), and automated changelog entries so downstream consumers see the release notes without manual steps. Changes: add model metadata JSON, add perf profile JSON (GPU and CPU reference configs), update the changelog-generator to recognize registry additions and emit a standardized release_notes entry, add docs page and quickstart snippet. Checklist: - [x] Model metadata (description, tokenizer, architecture, license) - [x] Performance profiles (latency throughput matrices, recommended instance types) - [x] Automation hook for changelog generation (release_notes templates) - [x] Docs page + example inference config - [x] Unit and integration tests for perf profile parsing - [x] CI green and perf-regression check passed How to validate: use registry CLI: `rw model show peregrine-11b@v1.0`, run `rw perf simulate --profile peregrine-11b-v1.0` to validate expected throughput, and verify changelog updated by running `scripts/generate-changelog --since HEAD~1` Notes: perf profiles include conservative and aggressive configs; conservative is default for Dedicated. The changelog automation is feature-flagged behind REGISTRY_CHANGELOG_AUTOGEN and will only run in release pipelines. Related: addresses ENG-4821 for onboarding cadence and PM-233 product request.
